setup.welcomeText: Your Anki decks, Quizlet sets and AI stories, on your own server. Setup takes about two minutes.
setup.adminText: You'll log in with this. You can add more people later.
setup.usernameShort: Use at least 2 characters for the username
setup.passwordShort: Use at least 8 characters for the password
setup.profileText: A profile is an Anki collection: your decks and review history. Make one per person, or per language.
setup.connectionLost: The connection dropped. Try again; nothing is lost.
setup.syncText: Sync with Anki on your other devices, now or later in Settings → Sync.
setup.syncAnkiweb: Log in with your AnkiWeb account and download your collection.
setup.syncHereTitle: A sync server on this AnkiBase
setup.syncHere: Anki's own sync server, run here: Anki on your phone and computer sync with your server instead of AnkiWeb.
setup.syncHereForm: Choose a username and password for it; you'll use them in Anki on your other devices too.
setup.syncOwn: A self-hosted Anki sync server you already run.
setup.syncNone: No sync for now. Import decks or add cards here.
setup.chooseLater: Both sides have changes. Pick which one to keep in Settings → Sync → One-way sync.
setup.aiText: With an API key from one of these providers, AnkiBase turns your words into short stories with tap-to-translate. Everything else works without it.
setup.doneText: A few things you might want next:
setup.tipUsers: Invite family or friends in Settings → Users and give each their own profile.
setup.tipSync: Run Anki's sync server here (Settings → Sync) so all your devices sync with your own server.
setup.tipPhone: The AnkiBase apps for Android and iPhone study offline and sync when you're back online.
